definitions.explanation: A professional who designs buildings and oversees their construction. Requires certification in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{建築家|けんちくか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{設計|せっけい}して→設計する：26916_sekkeisuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had a famous architect design my house.

examples.japanese: {建築家|けんちくか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦には→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{資格|しかく}→資格：02834_shikaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: You need qualifications to become an architect.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{美術館|びじゅつかん}→美術館：01717_bijutsukan⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本人|にほんじん}→日本人：10112_nihonjin⟧{建築家|けんちくか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: This museum is the work of a Japanese architect.

notes:
COMPOUND: ⟦{建築|けんちく}→建築：02709_kenchiku⟧ (architecture, construction) + ⟦{家|か}→家：noentry⟧ (professional, expert)

PROFESSIONAL TERMS:
・⟦{一級建築士|いっきゅうけんちくし}→一級建築士：29181_ikkyuukenchikushi⟧ (first-class architect - highest license)
・⟦{二級建築士|にきゅうけんちくし}→二級建築士：29182_nikyuukenchikushi⟧ (second-class architect)
・⟦{建築士|けんちくし}→建築士：24974_kenchikushi⟧ (registered architect - official title)

DISTINCTION: {建築家|けんちくか} is the general term often used for creative/artistic architects, while ⟦{建築士|けんちくし}→建築士：24974_kenchikushi⟧ is the official licensed professional title.

FAMOUS JAPANESE ARCHITECTS: ⟦{安藤忠雄|あんどうただお}→安藤忠雄：noentry⟧, ⟦{隈研吾|くまけんご}→隈研吾：noentry⟧, ⟦{磯崎新|いそざきあらた}→磯崎新：noentry⟧
